# Cheap Quantum Computers

> Pathfinder Quantum (The New Computers) is building cheap, manufacturable quantum computers. This site holds the mission essay and the hardware blueprints.

The human site is a client-rendered React app, so HTML routes are empty without JavaScript. Use the markdown pages below. They are generated from the same source as the visual pages.

## Pages

- [Site overview](https://thenewcomputers.com/index.md): What this project is and where the documents live
- [Mission](https://thenewcomputers.com/mission.md): Out of the Lab and Into the Factory — the full essay
- [Diamond QPU](https://thenewcomputers.com/blueprints/diamond-qpu.md): Pathfinder Diamond QPU v2.1, an NV-centre tabletop quantum computer on an RFSoC4x2 with silicon photonics
- [Blueprints](https://thenewcomputers.com/blueprints.md): Index of hardware designs

## Optional

- [Team](https://thenewcomputers.com/team.md): Recruiting posters
- [Join](https://thenewcomputers.com/join.md): Technical cofounder form
- [On-Chip Ion Trap paper](https://www.zk50.io/papers/pathfinder-pic-chip.pdf): Pathfinder PIC ion-trap design
- [Interactive 3D Diamond QPU bench](https://thenewcomputers.com/diamond-qpu-3d): Browser viewer, not a text document
